name: local_24gb
machine: the home PC: NVIDIA RTX 3090 24 GB, AMD Ryzen 9 5950X (16 cores / 32 threads), 64 GB DDR4, Fedora 44
rules: one GPU job at a time (the desktop also uses the GPU: ~1-1.5 GB of it)
the models wait in RAM between their stages (low VRAM): a job needs ~20-25 GB of RAM, so close big programs
a step that needs more than ~22 GB of GPU fails with 'out of memory'; scripts/tools/as_24gb.py tests that on the server
multi-view Pixal3D at 1536 fits with ~1.5 GB to spare: close other GPU programs (browser video, games)

measured.how: on the server's A40 with PyTorch capped at 22.5 GB (scripts/tools/as_24gb.py), Nov 23 2026; GPU GB = PyTorch's peak
